content-security-policy.name: content-security-policy
content-security-policy.title: Content Security Policy (CSP)
content-security-policy.score_description: Content Security Policy (CSP) implemented unsafely. This includes 'unsafe-inline' or data: inside script-src, overly broad sources such as https: inside object-src or script-src, or not restricting the sources for object-src or script-src.
content-security-policy.recommendation: Remove unsafe-inline and data: from script-src, overly broad sources from object-src and script-src, and ensure object-src and script-src are set.

antiClickjacking.info: The use of CSP's frame-ancestors directive offers fine-grained control over who can frame your site.

defaultNone.info: Denying by default using default-src 'none'can ensure that your Content Security Policy doesn't allow the loading of resources you didn't intend to allow.

insecureBaseUri.description: Restricts use of the <base> tag by using base-uri 'none', base-uri 'self', or specific origins.
insecureBaseUri.info: The <base> tag can be used to trick your site into loading scripts from untrusted origins.

insecureFormAction.description: Restricts where <form> contents may be submitted by using form-action 'none', form-action 'self', or specific URIs
insecureFormAction.info: Malicious JavaScript or content injection could modify where sensitive form data is submitted to or create additional forms for data exfiltration.

insecureSchemeActive.description: Blocks loading of active content over HTTP or FTP
insecureSchemeActive.info: Loading JavaScript or plugins can allow a man-in-the-middle to execute arbitrary code or your website. Restricting your policy and changing links to HTTPS can help prevent this.

insecureSchemePassive.description: Blocks loading of passive content over HTTP or FTP
insecureSchemePassive.info: This site's Content Security Policy allows the loading of passive content such as images or videos over insecure protocols such as HTTP or FTP. Consider changing them to load them over HTTPS.

strictDynamic.description: Uses CSP3's 'strict-dynamic' directive to allow dynamic script loading (optional)
strictDynamic.info: 'strict-dynamic' lets you use a JavaScript shim loader to load all your site's JavaScript dynamically, without having to track script-src origins.

unsafeEval.description: Blocks execution of JavaScript's eval() function by not allowing 'unsafe-eval' inside script-src
unsafeEval.info: Blocking the use of JavaScript's eval() function can help prevent the execution of untrusted code.

unsafeInline.description: Blocks execution of inline JavaScript by not allowing 'unsafe-inline' inside script-src
unsafeInline.info: Blocking the execution of inline JavaScript provides CSP's strongest protection against cross-site scripting attacks. Moving JavaScript to external files can also help make your site more maintainable.

unsafeInlineStyle.description: Blocks inline styles by not allowing 'unsafe-inline' inside style-src
unsafeInlineStyle.info: Blocking inline styles can help prevent attackers from modifying the contents or appearance of your page. Moving styles to external stylesheets can also help make your site more maintainable.

unsafeObjects.info: Blocking the execution of plug-ins via object-src 'none' or as inherited from default-src can prevent attackers from loading Flash or Java in the context of your page.

cross-origin-resource-sharing.name: cross-origin-resource-sharing
cross-origin-resource-sharing.title: Cross Origin Resource Sharing (CORS)
cross-origin-resource-sharing.score_description: Content is visible via cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) files or headers, but is restricted to specific domains.

redirection.name: redirection
redirection.title: Redirection
redirection.score_description: Does not redirect to an HTTPS site.
redirection.recommendation: Redirect to the same host on HTTPS first, then redirect to the final host on HTTPS.

strict-transport-security.name: strict-transport-security
strict-transport-security.title: Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
strict-transport-security.score_description: Strict-Transport-Security header set to a minimum of six months (15768000).
strict-transport-security.recommendation: Consider preloading: this requires adding the preload and includeSubDomains directives and setting max-age to at least 31536000 (1 year), and submitting your site to https://hstspreload.org/.

subresource-integrity.name: subresource-integrity
subresource-integrity.title: Subresource Integrity
subresource-integrity.score_description: Subresource Integrity (SRI) is implemented and all scripts are loaded securely.

x-frame-options.name: x-frame-options
x-frame-options.title: X-Frame-Options
x-frame-options.score_description: X-Frame-Options (XFO) implemented via the CSP frame-ancestors directive.

cross-origin-resource-policy.name: cross-origin-resource-policy
cross-origin-resource-policy.title: Cross Origin Resource Policy
cross-origin-resource-policy.score_description: Cross Origin Resource Policy (CORP) is not implemented (defaults to cross-origin).
